checks.why: a constructor with no initializer runs its base class's parameterless constructor
through a generic base: PersonMap() runs Map<string>()
a class that declares no constructor runs its base's at every `new`
control: `: base(name)` runs the named constructor, so the parameterless one gains no resolved caller from it
control: a constructor that delegates with `: this(..)` runs no base constructor itself (the one it delegates to does)
the explicit base call keeps its own edge
